title: Stay Aware
body: Always be aware of your surroundings and trust your instincts if something feels off.

title: Emergency Contacts
body: Keep emergency contacts saved in your phone and your safety app.

title: Share Your Location
body: Share your live location with a trusted contact when traveling alone.

title: Quick SOS Access
body: Enable quick access to the SOS feature in your app for emergencies.

title: Public Spaces
body: Stay in public, well-lit areas when waiting for transportation.

title: Voice Command
body: Use the voice-activated SOS feature when you can't reach your phone.

title: Trust Your Instincts
body: If you feel uncomfortable or unsafe, leave the area immediately.

title: Safe Commutes
body: Use verified transport services and avoid sharing rides with strangers.

title: Secure Your Home
body: Always lock your doors and windows when you're home alone.

title: Battery Check
body: Keep your phone and wearable device charged for emergencies.

title: Safety Check-In
body: Regularly check in with loved ones, especially when traveling.

title: Safe Routes
body: Use the app's safe route feature to avoid high-risk areas.

title: Wearable Alerts
body: Test your wearable device regularly to ensure all safety features work.

title: Emergency Codes
body: Establish a secret code with loved ones to signal distress.

title: Stay Informed
body: Check real-time safety alerts and be aware of red zones.

title: Personal Defense
body: Carry personal safety tools like pepper spray and know how to use them.

title: Night Safety
body: Avoid walking alone at night; use the app to notify contacts.

title: Geofence Alerts
body: Set geofence alerts to notify loved ones if you leave safe zones.

title: Secure Rides
body: Double-check the driver's identity before entering a ride.

title: Emergency Drills
body: Familiarize yourself with the app's emergency features regularly.

title: Stay Anonymous
body: Avoid sharing personal details with strangers online or in person.

title: Check-In Timer
body: Set check-in reminders when traveling so loved ones know you're safe.

title: Be Visible
body: When in distress, move to visible areas where others can help.

title: Avoid Routine
body: Change your daily routes and schedules to stay unpredictable.

title: Report Suspicious
body: Report any suspicious behavior immediately to authorities.

title: Secure Devices
body: Enable biometric access on your phone and safety app.

title: Backup Plan
body: Have a backup phone charger or power bank when traveling.

title: Know Exits
body: Always identify exits in unfamiliar buildings or public spaces.

title: Emergency Mode
body: Activate emergency tracking if you sense danger while commuting.

title: Be Confident
body: Walk with purpose and confidence to avoid appearing vulnerable.

title: Community Support
body: Use the app's community chat to stay connected with others nearby.

title: Trustworthy Contacts
body: Only share your location with people you trust.

title: Unfamiliar Areas
body: Use the app to identify and avoid high-crime neighborhoods.

title: Sound Alarm
body: Trigger your wearable alarm if you feel threatened.

title: Stay Covered
body: Be cautious of sharing your personal schedule or plans online.

title: Watch Drinks
body: Never leave your drink unattended in public places.

title: Speed Dial
body: Add emergency numbers to your phone's speed dial.

title: Safe Entry
body: Avoid isolated building entrances or underground parking alone.

title: Weather Safety
body: Be extra cautious in extreme weather conditions while commuting.

title: Noise Distraction
body: Avoid using headphones in unknown or unsafe areas.

title: In Case of Emergency
body: Use the SOS button immediately if you feel threatened.

title: Stay Updated
body: Keep your app updated to access the latest safety features.

title: Silent Alerts
body: Enable silent SOS alerts to notify emergency contacts discreetly.

title: Avoid Isolated Paths
body: Stick to busy and well-lit paths, especially at night.

title: Keep Proof
body: Take photos or record audio if you feel unsafe or threatened.

title: Travel Smart
body: Pre-book rides and verify vehicle details before getting in.

title: Location History
body: Keep a log of your routes for future reference and safety.

title: Group Travel
body: Travel with friends when possible to enhance safety.

title: Backup Contact
body: Have multiple emergency contacts in case one is unavailable.

title: Avoid Confrontation
body: If approached, seek help rather than engaging with a threat.

title: Signal for Help
body: Use the voice command or SOS button to request immediate assistance.
